modifications: Converted from TEI XML to plain text paragraphs with emphasis, with the long s printed as s. The commentary is read as Hosea 13:12 to 16, one section per verse, each keyed by the verse its heading names, such as HOSEA 13. 12. or VERSE 13., with the observations on that verse. The brief history of the twenty kings of Israel and the catalogue of those kings, printed after the observations on verse 16, stay with that verse. A verse named in the commentary is never read. Every gap the transcribers could not key is kept as the mark they gave it, such as • for an illegible letter and 〈◊〉 for an illegible word. Line-end hyphens are closed up. Left out: the title page, the dedication to the City of London, the epistle to the reader, the table of the principal things and the table of the texts explained.
